# QS-CFW-8165-49 Quality specification - flange blank CFW-8165-49 (4140) Rev C

Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-8165-49

Scope
This document defines the quality requirements and inspection method for flange blank CFW-8165-49 (4140) produced at Plant P2. It applies to incoming forgings from forging operations and to final inspection prior to release to machining.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Material | 4140 |
| Hardness | The hardness range for flange blank CFW-8165-49 (CFW-8165-49) is 36-42 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for flange blank CFW-8165-49 (CFW-8165-49) is ±0.06 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for flange blank CFW-8165-49 (CFW-8165-49) is 25.2 kg. |
| Surface condition | Free of cracks, laps, and cold shuts; scale consistent with standard forging practice. |

Inspection method
- Hardness: Confirm hardness using a calibrated Rockwell tester on representative locations specified by the inspection plan. Record readings and verify conformity to The hardness range for flange blank CFW-8165-49 (CFW-8165-49) is 36-42 HRC.
- Dimensional: Measure the bore using calibrated bore gauges. Verify the bore diameter against nominal and ensure The bore diameter tolerance for flange blank CFW-8165-49 (CFW-8165-49) is ±0.06 mm.
- Weight: Verify forging weight where applicable using calibrated scales and confirm it does not exceed The maximum forging weight for flange blank CFW-8165-49 (CFW-8165-49) is 25.2 kg.
- Visual: Perform visual and tactile inspection for surface defects. Inspect heat treatment evidence and mark condition per shop practice.

Nonconformance handling
Nonconforming items shall be segregated and tagged. Report nonconformances to Quality and Operations for disposition. Disposition options include rework, scrap, or concession in accordance with company procedure. Rework must not be performed if it would compromise the hardness requirement, bore tolerance, or maximum forging weight specified above. Documentation of disposition shall be retained with the lot record.
